title: 第147章 线索第146章 初秋
content_zh:
秋天越来越深了。院子里的枣树叶子开始变黄，一片一片地落下来，落在石桌上，落在井台上，落在青石板缝里。方圆每天早晨扫一遍，扫完了又落，落了又扫。他不再像以前那样等着树长大，等着花开，等着果熟。他已经习惯了。
这天傍晚，院门被人敲响了。敲门声不急不缓，每三下停顿一次。方圆放下手里的扫帚，走到门口，打开门。门外站着一个中年男人，穿着一件半旧的灰袍子，面容普通，丢在人群里很难记住。但他手里拿着一个木匣子，匣子不大，长宽各一尺，像是装着一件重要的东西。“你是方圆？”“是我。”“有人让我把这东西交给你。”中年男人把木匣子递过来，“他说你看了就知道了。”方圆接过木匣子，入手沉甸甸的。他打开匣盖。里面是一封信，和一块石头。石头是黑色的，巴掌大小，光滑如镜。方圆的手猛地攥紧——这石头和他在极北冰原地下世界里见过的那块石头一模一样。他拿起信，展开。信纸上只有一句话——“方家的秘密，不在封印里。在方家祖坟的地下。方沧海。”是父亲的笔迹。
方圆站在门口，手里握着那块黑色的石头，沉默了很长时间。他没有问中年男人是谁送来的，也没有问他从哪里来。中年男人见他接了东西，转身就走了。方圆站在门口，看着那人的背影在暮色中越走越远，直到消失在巷子口。然后他关上门，走回院子里，在石凳上坐下，把那块石头放在石桌上。
王紫璇从厨房出来，看到他手里的石头，看到他的脸色不对。“怎么了？”方圆没有回答，把信递给她。王紫璇看完，也沉默了一会儿。“你父亲留下的？”“嗯。”方圆握着那块石头，“他说方家的秘密不在封印里，在方家祖坟的地下。”
第二天一早，方圆去了方家。他没有去找方正阳，直接去了后院。方家祖坟在方家府邸后面的山坡上，是一片安静的地方，种着几棵松树。方圆站在山坡上，看着那些墓碑。松针在脚底铺了厚厚一层，踩上去一点声音也没有。他在山坡上站了很久，像是在等秋天帮他指一条路。然后他在最老的那几座墓碑前面蹲下来，用手扒开地面的泥土。泥土很松，像是被人翻过不久。他拨开几层土后，手指碰到了一个硬物。他小心地挖开周围的土，露出一块石板。石板不大，只有一尺见方，上面刻着符文——和他在极北冰原地下见过的符文一样。方圆把石板掀开，下面是一个暗格。暗格里放着一个石盒。他拿起石盒，打开盖子。里面放着一本泛黄的手记，封面上写着“方氏手记”四个字，是毛笔写的，字迹端正，一笔一划都很用力。方圆翻开第一页，上面写着：“方家先祖方天岳，于天玄历元年奉天命守印。然封印非万魔之祖全部。万魔之祖乃天外之物，其本体仍在虚空深处游荡。天命玉只能锁其心，不能灭其魂。若本体寻来，天命玉亦不可挡。方家世代守印，非为封印，乃为等待。”
方圆合上手记，抬头看着山坡上的松树。他父亲留下的这段话，像是把一扇本来已经关好的门又推开了一条缝，让他知道外面还有风。他没有立刻下山，只是坐在山坡上，翻着那本手记。越往后翻，字迹越潦草，像是写字的人越来越急。最后一页只有两行字：“若你看到这些，说明我已经不在了。不要来找我。不要相信天机阁主。”方圆的手停在那一页上。不要相信天机阁主——他父亲让他不要相信天机阁主。可天机阁主把他引向了虚空吞噬者，给了他天玄剑，陪他在祭坛里等了那么久。如果父亲说的没错，那他到底在等什么？
他把手记收好，把石板盖回去，把土填平。站起来的时候，山风把他手里的泥土吹走了一些，落在鞋面上又滑下去。他沿着山坡慢慢走下来，回到方家府邸。方正阳正坐在正堂里喝茶，看到他进来，放下茶杯。“你去祖坟了？”“去了。”“发现了什么？”“一本手记。我父亲留下的。”方正阳沉默了一会儿，“他从来没跟我说过。”“他说，方家的秘密不在封印里。他说，不要相信天机阁主。”方正阳的手微微一顿，像是从来没想过方沧海会留下这种东西。他沉默了很久才开口，“你打算怎么办？”“去一趟中州城，见陆长老。”
回到院子，王紫璇正在给那棵杏树浇水。她看到他脸色很差，没有问。方圆把那块黑色石头和手记放在石桌上。“你父亲留下的？”“嗯。他说不要相信天机阁主。”“那你信吗？”方圆沉默了一会儿，“不知道。”
第二天一早，方圆骑马出了青州城，向北奔去。走了一天，在一个驿站停下来过夜。他躺在床上的时候，把那本手记又翻了一遍。里面的内容反复提到了“虚空中的本体”，像是父亲在生命最后一段时间里想的都是这件事，担忧的也都是这件事。他合上手记，闭上眼睛，觉得自己好像又把一扇门推开了一条缝，而那条缝里的风吹出来，带着不属于这个秋天的凉意。
走了十天，到了中州城。他直接去了城东，陆长老住的地方。推开院门，陆长老正坐在院子里的竹椅上晒着太阳，闭着眼睛，像是睡着了。方圆在他对面坐下，等了一会儿，陆长老睁开眼睛，“你来了。”“我找到了一本我父亲留下的手记。他说，方家的秘密不在封印里。他说，不要相信天机阁主。”陆长老没有说话。他的目光很平静，像是早就知道这些。他沉默了很久，“那你信吗？”方圆没有回答。陆长老继续说道，“你父亲当年也来找过我，说了同样的话。我没有回答他。后来他就走了，走了之后，再也没有回来。”方圆的手微微攥紧，“你知道他要说什么？”“我知道。”陆长老低下头，“天机阁主是个好人，但他不是我们这个世界的人。他来自虚空之外。”方圆的手猛地收紧，“虚空之外？”“他是跟着万魔之祖来的。万魔之祖坠落之后，他也落在了天玄大陆。他一直在等万魔之祖的本体找过来，不是为了救我们，是为了让我们替他挡在前面。”
方圆沉默了很长时间。他没有再问。他站起来，走到门口，又停下来。“那你为什么还要帮他？”“因为我没有别的选择。没有他，天玄大陆早就没了。不管他是什么目的，他做的事，确实救了这里的人。”方圆没有说话，推开门走了出去。夕阳把巷子染成暖黄色，他沿着巷子走了一段路，又停下来，抬头看着天空。天空很蓝，云很白，看不出有一条裂缝正悬在看不见的高处，也看不出有人在等它打开。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
Autumn is getting deeper and deeper. The leaves of the jujube trees in the yard began to turn yellow, and fell one by one, falling on the stone table, the well platform, and the cracks in the bluestone slabs. Fangyuan sweeps it every morning, sweeps it again, puts it down again, and sweeps it again. He no longer waits for the trees to grow, for the flowers to bloom, and for the fruits to ripen like before. He's used to it.
That evening, there was a knock on the courtyard door. The knocks on the door were slow and slow, with a pause every three times. Fangyuan put down the broom in his hand, walked to the door, and opened it. There was a middle-aged man standing outside the door. He was wearing a half-worn gray robe and had an ordinary face. It was difficult to remember him among the crowd. But he was holding a wooden box in his hand. The box was not big, one foot long and one foot wide. It seemed to contain something important. "Are you Fangyuan?" "It's me." "Someone asked me to give this to you." The middle-aged man handed the wooden box over, "He said you'll know when you look at it." Fangyuan took the wooden box and held it heavily. He opened the lid. Inside was a letter and a stone. The stone is black, palm-sized, and smooth as a mirror. Fangyuan's hands clenched suddenly - this stone was exactly the same as the stone he had seen in the underground world of the Arctic ice sheet. He picked up the letter and unfolded it. There was only one sentence on the letter - "The secret of the Fang family is not in the seal. It is under the ancestral grave of the Fang family. Fang Canghai." It was his father's handwriting.
Fangyuan stood at the door, holding the black stone in his hand, and was silent for a long time. He did not ask the middle-aged man who sent it, nor where he came from. When the middle-aged man saw him taking the things, he turned around and left. Fangyuan stood at the door, watching the man's back walking farther and farther in the dusk until he disappeared at the entrance of the alley. Then he closed the door, walked back to the yard, sat down on the stone bench, and put the stone on the stone table.
Wang Zixuan came out of the kitchen, saw the stone in his hand, and saw that his expression was wrong. "What's wrong?" Fangyuan didn't answer and handed the letter to her. Wang Zixuan was silent for a while after reading it. "Left by your father?" "Yes." Fang Yuan held the stone, "He said that the secret of the Fang family is not in the seal, but in the underground of the Fang family's ancestral grave."
Early the next morning, Fangyuan went to Fang's house. He didn't go to Fang Zhengyang and went directly to the backyard. The Fang family's ancestral grave is on the hillside behind the Fang family's mansion. It is a quiet place with a few pine trees. Fangyuan stood on the hillside and looked at the tombstones. There was a thick layer of pine needles on the soles of the feet, making no sound at all when stepped on. He stood on the hillside for a long time, as if waiting for autumn to show him a way. Then he squatted down in front of the oldest tombstones and dug up the soil on the ground with his hands. The soil was very loose, as if it had been plowed recently. After he pushed aside several layers of soil, his fingers touched a hard object. He carefully dug away the surrounding soil to reveal a slab of stone. The stone slab was not big, only one foot square, and it was engraved with runes - the same runes he had seen underground in the far north ice field. Fangyuan opened the stone slab, and there was a hidden compartment underneath. There is a stone box in the secret room. He picked up the stone box and opened the lid. There was a yellowed notebook inside, with the four words "Fang's Notes" written on the cover. It was written with a brush. The handwriting was regular and each stroke was very vigorous. Fangyuan turned to the first page, which read: "Fang Tianyue, the ancestor of the Fang family, was ordered by Heaven to keep the seal in the first year of Tianxuan Li. However, the seal is not the whole of the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Demons. The Ancestor of Ten Thousand Demons is an extraterrestrial thing, and its body is still wandering in the depths of the void. The Destiny Jade can only lock its heart, but cannot destroy its soul. If the main body is found, the Destiny Jade cannot stop it. The Fang family has kept the seal for generations, not to seal, but to wait."
Fangyuan closed the note and looked up at the pine trees on the hillside. The words left by his father were like pushing a closed door open a crack, letting him know that there was still wind outside. He didn't go down the mountain immediately. He just sat on the hillside and flipped through the notebook. The further back you turn, the more scrawled the handwriting becomes, as if the person writing is getting more and more anxious. There are only two on the last pageLine text: "If you see these, it means I am no longer here. Don't come to me. Don't believe the Master of Tianji Pavilion." Fang Yuan's hand stopped on that page. Don’t believe the Lord of the Tianji Pavilion—his father told him not to trust the Lord of the Tianji Pavilion. But the Master of Tianji Pavilion led him to the Devourer of the Void, gave him the Tianxuan Sword, and waited with him at the altar for so long. If what his father said was right, what on earth was he waiting for?
He put the notebook away, covered the stone slab back, and filled it with soil. When he stood up, the mountain wind blew some of the dirt away from his hands, and it fell on his shoes and slipped off. He walked slowly down the hillside and returned to the Fang family mansion. Fang Zhengyang was sitting in the main hall drinking tea. When he saw him coming in, he put down his tea cup. "Did you go to the ancestral grave?" "Yes." "What did you find?" "A notebook. It was left by my father." Fang Zhengyang was silent for a while, "He never told me." "He said that the secrets of the Fang family are not in the seal. He said, don't believe the Master of Tianji Pavilion." Fang Zhengyang's hand paused slightly, as if he had never thought that Fang Canghai would leave such a thing. He was silent for a long time before speaking, "What are you going to do?" "Go to Zhongzhou City and see Elder Lu."
Back in the yard, Wang Zixuan was watering the apricot tree. She saw that his expression was very bad, so she didn't ask. Fangyuan put the black stone and the note on the stone table. "Left by your father?" "Yes. He said not to believe the Master of Tianji Pavilion." "Then do you believe it?" Fang Yuan was silent for a while, "I don't know."
Early the next morning, Fangyuan rode out of Qingzhou City and ran north. After walking for a day, we stopped at a station for the night. While lying on the bed, he turned over the notebook again. The content inside repeatedly mentioned the "origin in the void", as if this was what my father was thinking about and worrying about in the last period of his life. He closed the note and closed his eyes, feeling as if he had pushed the door open a crack again, and the wind blew out of that crack, carrying a coolness that did not belong to this autumn.
After walking for ten days, we arrived at Zhongzhou City. He went directly to the east of the city, where Elder Lu lived. Pushing open the courtyard door, Elder Lu was sitting on a bamboo chair in the courtyard, basking in the sun, with his eyes closed, as if he was asleep. Fang Yuan sat down opposite him and waited for a while. Elder Lu opened his eyes and said, "You're here." "I found a notebook left by my father. He said that the secrets of the Fang family are not in the seal. He said, don't believe the Master of Tianji Pavilion." Elder Lu did not speak. His eyes were calm, as if he already knew this. He was silent for a long time, "Then do you believe it?" Fangyuan did not answer. Elder Lu continued, "Your father came to me back then and said the same thing. I didn't answer him. Then he left and never came back." Fang Yuan's hands clenched slightly, "Do you know what he was going to say?" "I know." Elder Lu lowered his head, "Master Tianji Pavilion is a good man, but he is not me. He is from outside the void." Fang Yuan tightened his hands suddenly, "Outside the void?" "He came with the ancestor of all demons. After the ancestor of all demons fell, he also fell into the Tianxuan continent. He was not trying to save us, but to let us stand in front of him."
Fangyuan was silent for a long time. He didn't ask again. He stood up, walked to the door, and stopped again. "Then why are you helping him?" "Because I have no other choice. Without him, Tianxuan Continent would have been gone long ago. No matter what his purpose was, what he did really saved the people here." Fang Yuan said nothing, opened the door and walked out. The setting sun dyed the alley a warm yellow color. He walked along the alley for a while, then stopped and looked up at the sky. The sky is very blue and the clouds are very white. There is no crack hanging at an invisible height, and no one is waiting for it to open.
